title: China's draft AI rules have measures to protect kids, like time limits and parental consent, ban gambling promotion content, and add suicide chats restrictions (Osmond Chia/BBC)
summary: Osmond Chia / BBC: China's draft AI rules have measures to protect kids, like time limits and parental consent, ban gambling promotion content, and add suicide chats restrictions — China has proposed strict new rules for artificial intelligence (AI) to provide safeguards for children and prevent chatbots …
